dedupe_keys.name: ltpp infopave long term pavement performance data portal fhwa

description: LTPP InfoPave is the portal of FHWA's Long-Term Pavement Performance program, which collects research-quality pavement performance data from in-service test sections across the United States and Canada. Data tables are organised under structure, climate, traffic and performance; six analysis-ready datasets (ARMAD, ARCFD, ARCLD, ARTRD, ARPED and ARMRD) cover materials, construction, climate, traffic, performance and maintenance and rehabilitation. Tools include section summary reports comparing up to four sections and exporting up to 12 to Excel, data availability views, section mapping, section timelines of construction and maintenance events and a pavement cross-section viewer; an interstate pavement condition sampling visualisation is also offered. Coverage: LTPP test sections in the US and Canada. Format and access: web portal with downloads. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the home page. Caveats: test sections are a sample, not a network inventory. It supports resilience and climate adaptation studies of pavement deterioration and model calibration. It relates to HPMS and the National Bridge Inventory in the catalogue.
